name: 云径禅寺
status: implemented_in_project; see acceptance-report.json for what is and is not verified
source_of_truth: app/src/site.js (buildSite). Numbers here are read from it; if they disagree, the code is right.
units: metres; +y up; north/uphill is -z; the visitor arrives from +z

zones.name: 竹林入口
objects: 望江亭（起点平台上的亭子）
竹林（真竹约一千四百竿，墙外另有画出来的远竹）
zones.collision: deck (landing); the grove is an `open` solid: not walkable, but nothing solid

zones.name: 上山石阶
objects: 第三段石阶（向北，升 4 米）
第二段石阶（向西，升 4.5 米）
第一段石阶（向北，升 6 米）
zones.floor: treads 0.34 m deep, about 0.18 m high, walked as treads not slopes
zones.collision: ramps (stairs) carved over solids; pavilion columns are posts

zones.name: 照壁
objects: 照壁「雙徑歸堂」11 米宽 4.2 米高，瓦顶
zones.collision: screen wall is a solid; you go round either end

zones.name: 重阁山门
objects: 山门下层五间（明间通行，次间版门）
zones.floor: platform 0.5 m, four steps front and back
zones.collision: solid except the middle bay (deck); bell and drum can be struck

zones.name: 第一个院落
objects: 大雄宝殿（重檐七间，月台，勾阑）
zones.collision: halls are solids with doors; the censer eases you round it

lighting.preset: J01 阴天雨后 = season summer, time day
lighting.main_light: overcast sky (hemisphere light); a weak, cool directional light from the south-east only to shape forms
lighting.local_light: none by day; hall windows and lamps at dusk and night
lighting.fog: exponential, density 0.0056, cool grey-green; the nearest wooded ridge is mixed toward it by hand so it still reads
lighting.wetness: paving: standing water only in hollows; stone tops damp; column feet and wall feet dark with damp

deferred: 四季四时的其余十五种
unknowns: bracket sets, rafters and column proportions are not checked against the Yingzao Fashi
